The result is that `credential.key` gets overwritten with `{"success":true,"data":{"access_token":...}}` instead of the flat token object. This is **not gated by `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED`** — it fires on every Google Calendar token refresh for every deployment. The next time the credential is loaded, `googleCredentialSchema.parse(credential.key)` (top of `getCredentialKey`, unchanged) will fail, permanently breaking the calendar connection until the user disconnects/reconnects. TypeScript won't catch this because Prisma's `Json` field accepts any object shape.
